title: Volts, amps and ohms
description: An original animated explainer. Volts are the push, amps are the flow and ohms are the resistance, pictured as head, flow and a narrow pipe. Ohm's law (volts = amps × ohms), power = volts × amps, and why the stream's 245 W is about 20 A at 12 V but only about 5 A at 48 V: a quarter of the current, and a sixteenth of the heat lost in the same cable. Plus why low voltage is not the same as safe, and the rule that a hydro generator never runs without a load.
